# Context menus plugin: one true source on axHub, Claude-generated by coder level

Build `context-menus-plugin-one-true-source` · branch `claude/context-menus-plugin-one-true-source` · PR #659

## Brett said (verbatim, Nov 13 2026 20:14)
> integrated with the UI manager; stores its data in one true source on axHub accessible from any plugin; contains the context menus, which are effectively assets; lists all the context menus; uses Claude to generate a context menu at advanced, pro, amateur, beginner coder levels, mapped out more meticulously depending on level

## What shipped
Phase 1 (Fable, s1): plugin `context-menus` (store `menus.mjs`, server routes, page with Generate / Drafts / Menus / Zones),
rules engine `framework/core/engines/context-menus-rules.mjs` + fixture + spec check, capability `context-menus@1`,
MCP / CLI / actions / voice. Android twin deferred in `framework/spec/PORTING.md`.

Phase 2 (Opus, s2–s8):
- **s2 Replaces the archived slim build.** Every right-click menu ends with a *Context menus* submenu: generate this
  page's menus at each coder level (labelled "(Claude not ready)" when the Claude badge isn't green; the action says why),
  the menus for the zone you clicked, open the page. The runtime has no disabled menu item, so the label carries the state.
- **s3 UI Manager.** `context-menus@1` (web) `forElement(el)` / `forZone(zone)`: the zone an element sits in, the items
  shown there and every menu that maps it. REST `GET /zones/{zone}/menus`, server `for_zone()`, CLI `menus.mjs zone`.
  No UI Manager plugin exists on main yet; it reads this capability (and the Zones tab links to it through
  `ui-elements@1` when it appears).
- **s4 One true source + registered actions.** Menus, history, drafts, which menu is in use and now the registered
  actions (`ctx-actions@1`, one file per owner) all sit in the hub's shared data. `POST /actions/register` (one owner or
  a batch), server `register_actions()`, web `registerActions()`, CLI `register-actions`. Each console registers its live
  actions per module once per session in one batched request. `GET /menus/{mid}/unknown-actions` names stale items.
- **s5 List.** Menus tab groups by app, zone (owner plugin / app and pages) or page; a menu shows under every zone it
  maps; zone filter. API `GET /index`, CLI `menus.mjs index`.
- **s6 Level per app and page.** A page's own menu is in use on that page only (`active.json` key `app/page`);
  consoles swap menus on navigation. Generate tab lists what is in force per app and page with a way back.
  `GET /active?page=`, `POST /unuse`, CLI `active --page`, `unuse`.
- **s7** Walked the five points end to end over the CLI on a clean store; help entries, README, plugin 0.2.0,
  control inventory regenerated.

## How each piece is reached (API parity)
| Feature | Deep link | REST | MCP (plugin command id) | CLI | Voice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Page / tabs | `context-menus.open:<tab>::<zone>` | `GET /state` | `state` | `menus.mjs list` | "list context menus" |
| Generate (level, app, page) | `context-menus.generate:<level>:<app>:<page>` | `POST /generate` | `generate` | `menus.mjs prompt` / `generate --reply-file` | "generate pro context menus" |
| Per element / zone | — | `GET /zones/{zone}/menus` | `zone-menus` | `menus.mjs zone <z>` | — |
| Register actions | — | `POST /actions/register` | `register-actions` | `menus.mjs register-actions` | — |
| Index per zone / page | `context-menus.open:menus::<zone>` | `GET /index` | `index` | `menus.mjs index` | — |
| In force per page | — | `GET /active?page=`, `POST /unuse` | `active`, `unuse` | `active --page`, `unuse` | "use menu <id>" |
